label.description: The name the Elementor editor will show for this class. Must start with a letter and hold only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores, and must not repeat a label this site already uses.

styles.description: Optional. The style properties the class applies at the desktop breakpoint, in Elementor's own prop vocabulary as elementor-global-class-list reports it. Omit to create an empty class that changes nothing until it is styled.

classDigest.description: A digest over the whole global class set and its order as stored, which is what verification compares.

classCount.description: How many global classes this site holds. This operation adds exactly one to it.
